title: Variational decomposition autoencoding improves disentanglement of latent representations
abstract: arXiv:2601.06844v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Understanding the structure of complex, nonstationary, high-dimensional time-evolving signals is a central challenge in scientific data analysis. In many domains, such as speech and biomedical signal processing, the ability to learn disentangled and interpretable representations is critical for uncovering latent generative mechanisms. Traditional approaches to unsupervised representation learning, including variational autoencoders (VAEs), often struggle to capture the temporal and spectral diversity inherent in such data. Here we introduce variational decomposition autoencoding (VDA), a framework that incorporates a strong structural bias toward signal decomposition into variational representation learning. translated_title: 变分分解自编码提升潜在表示的解耦性
translated_abstract: 理解复杂、非平稳、高维时变信号的结构是科学数据分析中的一个核心挑战。在语音和生物医学信号处理等许多领域中，学习解耦且可解释的表示对于揭示潜在的生成机制至关重要。传统的无监督表示学习方法，包括变分自编码器（VAE），往往难以捕捉此类数据中固有的时间与频谱多样性。在此，我们提出变分分解自编码（VDA），这是一个在变分表示学习中引入强烈结构偏置、偏向信号分解的框架。VDA通过变分分解自编码器（DecVAE）实现，即仅在编码器端的神经网络，在分布层面执行潜在自编码，以学习多个与时间（原文此处截断）对齐的潜在子空间。
tldr: 该论文提出变分分解自编码框架VDA，通过仅在编码器端的DecVAE网络在分布层面进行潜在自编码，将信号分解的结构偏置融入变分表示学习，从而更好地解耦复杂非平稳信号的潜在表示。
en_tdlr: The paper introduces Variational Decomposition Autoencoding (VDA), a framework that embeds a strong structural bias toward signal decomposition into variational representation learning via encoder-only DecVAEs, improving disentanglement of latent representations of complex, nonstationary signals.
